name: MPI-based Volume Partitioning
aliases: MPI-based Volume Partitioning — Chunk-based MPI parallelism
Spatial Division of Uniform Resolution Data
definition: A data parallel approach where the input volume is partitioned into chunks of contiguous slices, assigned to different MPI processes. Each process reads only its assigned slices.
summary: MPI-based Volume Partitioning spatially divides a volume into contiguous chunks for parallel rendering, distinguished by its fixed, regular grid that simplifies load balancing for uniform data.
